# <text-divider>

Horizontal divider with centered text. Use to separate content sections or provide alternative action labels.

- CSS-only custom element. Works without JavaScript.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/custom-elements/text-divider/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<text-divider>or</text-divider>
```
